text: Coffee with Magda this morning. Her mum's having a knee replacement next Tuesday and Magda's taking the week off to look after her. Remind me to text her the evening before to see how she's holding up.

Long catch-up with Florin and Agnieszka. They're off to Lisbon end of the month for their anniversary, first proper trip since the baby. Florin's still at the logistics firm, hates the commute. Should send them that list of restaurants before they go.

Kevin rang. His driving test is Friday at 9 and he's properly bricking it, third attempt. Text him good luck Thursday night. He also mentioned his sister Nora just got engaged, didn't know she was even seeing anyone.
Car MOT due end of the month. Book it in sometime next week, ideally not Wednesday.

Juan's moving to Glasgow early March for the new job at the uni. His girlfriend Lola is staying put for now till her course finishes over the summer. Sounds like they've thought it through. Offer to help him pack the weekend before.
Emeka's dog Bisi has to have a lump removed tomorrow. He was really worried, kept checking his phone the whole time we were at lunch. Message him tomorrow evening.
Finn and Anika's housewarming is this Saturday, from 7. I'm bringing the cheese board. Anika is vegan now so get the cashew one too.
Eilidh mentioned she's been learning the fiddle since January, plays with a trad group in Leith on Thursdays. Her partner Bao does the sound for them. Nice pair.
Tobi's leaving do was meant to be next Friday but it's been called off, he's not leaving after all, they matched the offer and bumped him to senior. Congratulate him properly when I see him.

Isla said Liam's grandad passed away at the weekend, funeral's sometime next week. Liam hasn't been in work since. I should send a card and drop a message to him tomorrow, not today, Isla said he's swamped with calls.

Elena has her citizenship interview in a fortnight. She's been revising the history stuff every night, quizzed me on kings and queens over dinner and got annoyed when I didn't know half of them either. Her husband Tobi is taking the morning off to drive her there. Remember to ring her the day after to find out how it went.

Lunch with Haruto Tanaka, first time in ages. He's training for the Edinburgh half in May, running five mornings a week and doing a long run every Sunday. Wife Claire thinks he's mad but she's secretly proud. Their eldest, Kenji, starts nursery after Christmas, and Claire's going back to work three days a week at the same time. Ask him in a fortnight how the training's going.
Need to pick up the dry cleaning before Thursday and drop the parcel back at the post office. Also renew the bus pass, runs out Sunday.
Colm said his brother Chidi... no, his flatmate Chidi, is doing a stand-up slot at the Stand next Wednesday. Colm's going, wants a crowd. Might go along, check if I'm free.

Camila mentioned her birthday's the 14th and she's been eyeing up a proper espresso machine, keeps sending links to the group chat. Could chip in with Siobhan and Nadia. Ask Siobhan this weekend if she's up for it.

Antoine's back from Marseille, his dad's recovering well after the heart op. Says he's flying back out in early March to help clear the house, they're selling it and moving his dad into a flat nearer his aunt. He seemed tired but okay. His girlfriend Nadia went with him for the first week. Should invite them both round for dinner sometime next week.
Alana got the job! Starts at the agency on the 3rd. Text her a proper congrats tonight, I only sent a thumbs up earlier which was rubbish.

Lin's cat Dumpling went missing on Sunday. They've put posters up all over Morningside and her partner Anil has been out with a torch every night. Lin is gutted, barely ate at lunch, keeps blaming herself for leaving the window open. Check in with her Wednesday, and share the post on the neighbourhood group tonight.
Heather and Yosef are getting married next summer, venue's booked, somewhere in the Borders. Heather asked if I'd do a reading. Need to say yes properly by the end of the week.
Nora's results come out Thursday. Fingers crossed for her.
Quick one: Anil prefers tea, no milk, and he's allergic to nuts. For when he comes round Saturday.
Beatriz Gonzalez called about the book club, moving it to next Tuesday because of half term. She's hosting this time. I'm doing dessert.
Bao's starting his PhD in October and he's nervous about the funding falling through. His mum keeps asking when he'll get a real job. Must ask him how the supervisor meeting went next week.
Dentist Monday 8.40. Gym kit in the car Sunday night so I don't forget. Haircut sometime next week.

Big catch-up with Magda, Florin and Agnieszka at the pub. Magda's finally handed in her notice, last day is end of the month, and she's going travelling round Vietnam over the summer. Florin's planning a surprise leaving drinks for her the Friday before she finishes, keep it quiet. Agnieszka is struggling a bit, her dad's dementia is getting worse and she's going home to Kraków for a fortnight in early March. Remind me to message Agnieszka the week she's away, and to sort a card for Magda.
Rang Kevin to see how the test went. Failed on a roundabout again. He's okay-ish, rebooking for sometime next month. Don't make a big deal of it.
Siobhan's mum turns 70 this weekend, big family do in Cork. Siobhan's flying over Friday evening.
Finn says Anika is pregnant, due early March. They're telling people slowly. Absolutely thrilled for them.
Emeka update: the vet said the lump was benign, Bisi's home and wearing the cone of shame. Emeka very relieved.

Called Juan. The flat in Glasgow fell through, so the move's pushed back to end of April. He's annoyed but staying positive. He mentioned he'd love a decent pair of hiking boots for when he's up there, gift idea for his birthday in May.
Claire wants to meet for brunch this weekend, Sunday probably. Should book somewhere near Stockbridge tomorrow.
Liam's back at work, seemed quiet. Funeral was Tuesday. Take him for a coffee sometime next week, just us.
Haruto's colleague Isla has just been promoted to team lead. He's a bit put out he didn't get it, says he'll go for the next one in the spring.
Chidi's gig at the Stand went brilliantly apparently, Colm sent videos. He's been asked back for a longer slot in a fortnight. Go to that one, definitely.
Tobi and his wife Elena are doing a charity bake sale at the kids' school next Saturday. Tobi asked if I'd bake. Make the lemon drizzle Friday evening.
Nadia's struggling with the new manager, says she's being micromanaged and dreads Mondays. Thinking of looking for something else in the new year. Check in on her end of next week.
Heather mentioned her nephew Finn got into Edinburgh to do medicine. Whole family is over the moon.
Just me this weekend: clear the garage Saturday morning, tip run after, then batch cook for the week. Sunday is a rest day, no excuses.
Antoine Petrov, the guy from Beatriz's book club, does pottery and has a kiln in his garage. Said I could come and try sometime over the summer.

Yosef rang. His mum's in hospital with a chest infection, probably out by Friday. Yosef sounded wiped out, he's been back and forth all week. Need to call him Thursday evening, and maybe drop round some food for the weekend.
Anil's daughter starts secondary in September, they're still waiting to hear which school. Decision letters come out early March. He's a bit anxious about it.

Lunch with Lola and Camila. Lola's applying for a masters in Amsterdam, deadline end of the month, wants me to read her personal statement. Camila's planning a trip to Colombia over Christmas to see her grandparents, first time in six years. Send Lola some feedback by Wednesday.
Alana's first day at the agency went fine, she said everyone was lovely but she's knackered. Her boyfriend Colm cooked her a celebration dinner.
Renew passport before the summer. Photos first, then the online form. Takes about three weeks apparently.

Agnieszka is back from Kraków. Her dad's moved into a care home, she's relieved but sad. She's thinking of going part time from next month to fly over more often. Must meet up with her before then, maybe Thursday.
Siobhan called from Cork, the party was lovely, her mum cried at the speeches. She brought me back a bottle of something. Nice.
Magda's leaving drinks are Friday at the Cumberland, 6 till late. I'm sorting the card and the collection, everyone's in except Kevin. Chase Kevin tomorrow morning.
Haruto ran the half in 1:52! Text him congrats tonight and ask about recovery.
Book flights for Lisbon over the summer, probably July. Check the bank holiday dates first.

Eilidh's partner Bao has a big presentation to the funding panel next Monday. He's been rehearsing on her every night. Eilidh says he's a wreck. Wish him luck Sunday evening. Also Eilidh's fiddle group is playing at a ceilidh the Saturday after, she wants us there.

Colm and Alana broke up, apparently it's been coming for months. The trip to Galway they had planned for next month is off. Alana's staying with her sister Heather for a while. Check in with her this weekend, nothing heavy.
Nora passed! Distinction in two of them. Get her a little something, she's been eyeing up a fancy fountain pen for ages.
Florin mentioned in passing that he's been doing Polish lessons, Tuesday evenings, so he can talk to Agnieszka's family properly. That's lovely.
Beatriz rang about the book club again. It's at hers next Tuesday after all, 7.30. Book is the Ishiguro one. Haven't started it. Read at least half by Sunday.
Bao said the funding panel went okay, they'll decide sometime next week. Ask him how it went once he hears.
Lin found Dumpling! Hiding in a neighbour's shed for four days. Lin over the moon. She's getting him microchipped Friday.

Kevin's partner Isla is running a stall at the Christmas market from the 5th of December, selling her candles. Kevin asked if I could help set up the first morning. Said yes. Need to be at the Mound by 8.
Just paid the council tax. Gas bill still to do before the 1st.

Finn rang late, Anika's had a scan and there's some concern about the baby's growth, they've got another appointment next Wednesday. Finn's trying to stay calm for her but he's clearly scared. Anika's mum is coming down to stay this weekend. I should ring Finn the day after the appointment, and maybe send Anika some flowers on Monday, something low key.

Chat with Camila. Her dad's retiring at the end of the month after 35 years on the buses, big party at the social club the Saturday after. She asked if I'd come. Her brother Antoine is making a slideshow. Must remember to get a card for her dad by Thursday.
